column1: # Expected permission-gate decision, tab, command text. Both hooks must agree on every line.
# Blank lines and # lines are skipped. An empty command stands for a tool call with no command field.
# git writes are the user's alone
# The boundary is a word edge, not a delimiter list, so quoting and paths do not smuggle a write
# A gated name inside a longer word is not an invocation

column2: unzip $(gh run download 1 --dir out; echo out)/a.zip

column1: # An explicit read method makes field flags read-only again
# gh writes, including the glued flag form and the unmethoded field flag

column2: gh api -X GET repos/o/r -X DELETE repos/o/r

column1: # graphql cannot be told apart from a mutation without reading the query body
# Every gh invocation in the command has to pass

column2: gh run download 1 && gh pr merge 5
